question: Please find out how widespread the appeal of our top five actors is. What percentage of our customers have rented films featuring these actors?
sql:
-- Calculate percentage of customers who rented films featuring top 5 actors
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * 
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) 
         FROM rental r
         JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
         JOIN film_actor fa ON i.film_id = fa.film_id
         WHERE fa.actor_id IN (
             SELECT a.actor_id
             FROM actor a
             JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
             GROUP BY a.actor_id
             ORDER BY COUNT(fa.film_id) DESC
             LIMIT 5
         )
        )
    / 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer)
    , 2) AS percentage;
